Delicious Vietnamese Seafood restaurant
Sep 2024 • Friends
My second time at this local traditional family seafood restaurant. Definitely service without the trimmings but super friendly and down to earth. the tables are traditional low tables with the low chairs and plenty of fresh sea food in tanks to choose from plus an extensive menu including chicken, pork, beef dishes.

Please note this is a local Vietnamese restaurant and if you are a westerner like me you will probably be the only one here. It is packed with locals, the menu is totally in Vietnamese and English really is not spoken by the staff. However the trade off of a bit of courage & going out of your comfort zone is sensational seafood at incredibly low prices - that the locals pay and not what is charged at the inflated Seafood restaurants that target tourists. I highly recommend it. I will keep on coming back!

Authentic Vietnamese Seafood Dinning Experience in Saigon
Oct 2023 • Friends
When you are looking for a local seafood & beer place without the pretense this place is it. A truly wide selection of Vietnamese style seafood served on traditional low tables and seating. Lots of friendly staff, your beer being constantly topped up until you say stop. A truly lovely way to spend with friends. Please note our menus were only in Vietnamese and I was definitely the only Westerner there that night. Come here with at least one Vietnamese friend as no one spoke English. This is an authentic Vietnamese family restaurant.

The food and flavours were all delicious and only at a fraction of the cost of Saigon restaurants that cater to tourists. Well worth eating here. I loved it!
